description:
Bridge the gap between cutting-edge research and production systems. Build and implement research prototypes that push the boundaries of memory augmentation and contextual AI.




WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Translate research papers and ideas into working prototypes

 - Collaborate with research scientists to implement novel algorithms

 - Build experimental systems for memory retrieval and contextual understanding

 - Optimize research code for production deployment

 - Design and run experiments to validate research hypotheses

 - Contribute to research publications and technical documentation

 - Bridge communication between research and engineering teams


WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

 - 3+ years of experience in research engineering or applied ML

 - Strong programming skills in Python and ML frameworks (PyTorch, TensorFlow)

 - Experience implementing research papers and prototyping novel ideas

 - Knowledge of machine learning fundamentals and deep learning

 - Ability to work independently and manage research projects

 - Strong problem-solving and analytical skills

 - Experience with experimentation frameworks and A/B testing

 - Good communication skills for cross-functional collaboration


NICE TO HAVE

 - Published research in ML, NLP, or related fields

 - Experience with retrieval systems and vector databases

 - Knowledge of cognitive science or human memory research

 - Background in NLP or information retrieval

 - Experience with large language models and embeddings

 - Contributions to open-source ML projects

 - PhD or Masters in Computer Science, ML, or related field
